title: sinwan-ui.json
description: Project configuration written by `sinwan-ui init` and read by `add`, `list`, `search`, `view` and `diff`.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation.

tsx.description: Whether the project uses TypeScript (`.tsx`) components.

css.description: Project-relative path of the stylesheet that receives the sinwan-ui theme (Tailwind CSS v4).

aliases.description: Import aliases that copied files use. Each one must resolve through `compilerOptions.paths` in the project's `tsconfig.json` or `jsconfig.json`.

registries.description: Additional registries addressed as `@namespace/name`. Each value is an item URL (or local path) template containing `{name}`.

packageManager.description: Package manager used to install the npm dependencies of added items. Detected from the lockfile by `init`.
